summary: Re-ran every Safety Gate test with the new ALIGN_WEBHOOK_SECRET in place. The secret was read only through dotenv inside test code and was never printed. Existing suites (test_safety_gate, _external, _live, test_align_status_external, test_webhook_off): 60 passed, 1 skipped (test_webhook_off skips because the secret is set, as expected). New live suite tests/test_safety_gate_iter144_full.py: 20/20 passed against the public URL. It links two real parents through the app's own flow: a TEST professional calls POST /api/professional/joint-alignment/cases, then both parents call POST /api/joint-alignment/manual-code. Results: (1) Valid signature applies, with and without the sha256= prefix. Wrong, empty or missing signatures, a wrong key, and the wrong headers (X-Signature, X-Hub-Signature, X-Hub-Signature-256, Authorization raw or Bearer) all return 401 and nothing is written. (2) A body re-serialised with different whitespace fails 401. (3) Timestamps in seconds, ms, quoted digits, ISO with an offset and ISO with Z are accepted. Old (seconds, ms or quoted), +400s in the future, ISO older than 6 minutes, ISO without a timezone, a garbage string and a boolean are all refused. (4) An equal or lower version is ignored and the stored version and both parents' bodies stay the same. Replaying an identical body returns 409. (5) restricted/auto_red with referral=parallel_parenting: both parents' GET /api/case-settings bodies are byte-identical, with the professional banner, limited features off, file_metadata all_removed, no banned words and no professional name. (6) Lock: default (standard, structured or restricted) and auto_red (standard or structured) are all ignored and the version stays at 20. A re-sent auto_red restricted with note_review applies (v26). A professional standard update lifts it: banner becomes null, plan_options false, and the full option list returns. (7) Plan options are byte-identical for both parents and parallel-only. Picks are per parent, and non-parallel or unknown picks are dropped. (8) No notifications: none of the collections that reference either parent's user_id or email changed between before and after the mode/referral updates. (9) Admin: align-status gives webhook_on true, last_update applied/ignored, all 5 reasons in rejected_30d, no-store and no secret. self-test returns ok true. align-ping returns {configured:false}. link-health returns ok false (amber, because of test refusals). Parents get 403 on link-health, align-status, export and self-test, and unauthenticated calls are refused. UI (Playwright): both linked parents see 'Some features are set by your professional for this case.' on /dashboard, and identical /case-settings text with 'Set by your professional' and no banned words. Neither sees 'Start with Safety' or Step 0. /safety-assessment redirects to /help, and the old /api/safety-assessment endpoints (questions, POST, me, history) return 404. Admin /admin/audit-log at 1920 and 390: no webhook-off note, paste guard at the top and inside the open 'How Align must sign updates'. 'Check this side' shows 'This side works…'. 'Ask Align for a test' shows 'Align's test address isn't set up yet.' The copied text includes the guard and no secret, the secret is not in the page HTML, and there is no horizontal overflow. The Admin nav dot (desktop, and the mobile drawer) shows data-ok=false, 'Align link needs attention'. Get Help loads (tel:911), and Quick exit goes to /calendar (title 'Calendar', no help text); Back skips /help.

minor.issue: Stale and locked (auto_red lock) updates return the same 200 {ok:true} as applied ones, so Align can't tell an update was ignored except through the admin panel. Acceptable by design, but worth considering a result field (e.g. 'applied'|'ignored') for Align's builder.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: it still says ALIGN_WEBHOOK_SECRET is UNSET and the webhook is OFF (503), which is no longer true. Do not write the secret value there.
critical_code_review_comments: case_safety.apply_update lock rule is correct: from restricted/auto_red, only set_by=professional, or auto_red+restricted, can write. Locked writes don't advance the version, so a later professional update with any higher version than the stored one applies.
safety_assessment_routes is still included in server.py although its main endpoints return 404 live. Consider removing the router include entirely so nothing can save answers if the guard changes.
Creating test cases through /api/professional/joint-alignment/cases fires best-effort invite emails (to @example.com test addresses). This is harmless but is the only email side effect seen.
seed_data_creation: TEST professional and parent users plus SA-XXXXXX cases were created through the real API and removed afterwards (users, joint_alignment_cases, case_safety, safety_audit_log rows for those cases, plan_option_picks). Refusal counters in safety_webhook_rejects were raised on purpose, so the admin dot is amber for 24h.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Secret is set; never print it. Load it via dotenv. Use the leaks() helper in test_safety_gate_iter144_full.py for any secret-leak assertion so pytest's assertion output can't show the value. Cache-Control comes back as 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' through ingress, so assert 'no-store' in header. ui_seed_iter144.py setup/cleanup gives two linked restricted parents for UI checks.
